Snapshot: a38f1c4c531ae9f73757091f6e143dc778ba851e (candidate); frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 114ecdae2bb5a4081eee0258f4c5d48cf89a3458. Opening and closing gates both exited 0; confirmed two raw-identical stroke files and bound snapshot.
Scope: Read every specified guidance/rubric window; both complete new lessons in EN and RU; all four EN/RU context-pair windows (8 word cards); 9 whole KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence, header, 17 whole JMdict entries, 2 whole KanjiPedia texts; all 377 typed pool rows; all proposals, adjudications, clarifications, outside-limit observations, and 3 exact navigation diffs. Every requested window returned completely with exit 0; none unread.
C1 CLEAN: Both lessons retain frozen readings, ten strokes, canonical radical 广/53 and source N3 community classification; KANJIDIC2 old-JLPT 2 is not a contradiction. Readings/examples, word senses, 坐る rare-form disclosure, seat/furniture and 椅子に座る notes, and attributed historical analyses/mnemonics are supported by the bound KANJIDIC2/JMdict/KanjiPedia evidence.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All requested relative links target existing cards; absent 座席 and 庭園 pages are correctly plain text. The 3 existing-word edits are wrapper-only and preserve visible prose, metadata, old links, and CRLF. Six comparisons are supported as introductory shape contrasts, but none receives ordinary active-negative quiz approval here.
C3 NEEDS FIX: Russian lessons are otherwise clear and natural; see the technical-term finding below. Navigation wrappers do not impair readability.
N001座→庭 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: seat/sit vs garden/yard; 座 also has seat/place senses and 庭 has area sense, but current labels are not equivalent. Shape contrast is justified; not a quiz guard.
N002座→広 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: seat/sit vs wide/spacious are distinct; shared 广 makes a useful shape contrast, not quiz approval.
N003座→店 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: seat/sit vs shop/store; the bound 店 merchant-home sense was considered, without label equivalence.
N004庭→座 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: garden/yard vs seat/sit; place-domain adjacency considered independently from N001, not a reverse inference or guard.
N005庭→度 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: garden/yard vs degree/occasion/time; no title overlap, but no quiz-mode approval.
N006庭→店 S-intro; ordinary-negative U: garden/yard vs shop/store; the bound merchant-home sense was considered, not treated as garden equivalence.
L001座 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: adjudication matches lesson and official evidence; other 座 senses are appropriately bounded.
L002庭 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: adjudication matches lesson and official evidence; additional 庭 sense is appropriately bounded.
A001 SOURCE_SUPPORTED_BOUNDED_CLARIFICATION: 座(ざ) summary is selective, not falsely exhaustive; disclosure and evidence agree.
A002 SOURCE_SUPPORTED_BOUNDED_CLARIFICATION: 庭園 «сад; парк» is supported; omitted area sense is a bounded choice.
NAV01 words/家庭.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 庭 linked to ../kanji/庭.md, no other content change.
NAV02 words/座る.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 座 linked to ../kanji/座.md, no other content change.
NAV03 words/庭.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 庭 linked to ../kanji/庭.md, no other content change.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; flagged 座/場 title-part and 居/立 posture-domain adjacency is accurately bounded (席 absent from pool). O002 LIMIT_NOT_NEW_GUARD; 庭/園 title-part overlap and 家/公 contextual adjacency are accurately bounded.
Findings: C3, moderate, kanji/座.md and kanji/庭.md, «Значение и происхождение»: the learner-facing technical label 会意形声 is not glossed, so a Russian beginner must understand untranslated Japanese classification vocabulary to follow the explanation. Add a short Russian gloss, e.g. «знак, в котором сочетаются смысловая и звуковая части (会意形声)». Evidence: both complete lessons; guidance/rubric require Russian comprehensibility and terminology support. Confidence: medium.
Optional: none.
Limits: No public dictionary pages were fetched; reviewed only the bound official excerpts/records. No tests, builds, validators, quiz runtime/UI or fallback behavior were run; thus all six active-negative safety dispositions remain UNVERIFIED, despite distinct current titles and supported introductory comparisons. This is not a native-speaker or runtime-acceptance claim.
